The '''swamp bantha''' was a [[Species/Legends|subspecies]] of [[Bantha/Legends|bantha]] that was brought to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Ohma-D'un/Legends|Ohma-D'un]]. It was smaller and less hairy than its desert relative. The swamp bantha was known for eating almost any plant.
